headline: Wheat and Corn Funds Fall to Three-Month Lows on Harvest Glut
summary: Wheat and corn funds fell to three-month lows as record crops and a harvest glut weighed on grain markets.
why: Agricultural commodity prices are heavily driven by global supply volumes, inventory levels, and seasonal harvest yields.

impacts.name: Wheat
impacts.why: The input reports that wheat and corn funds fell to three-month lows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Abundant harvest supplies and record crop yields created an oversupply condition, depressing agricultural futures prices.
